correctness.rationale: For each m,n>=4 the deleted-product cubical chain modules are computed as C_0=A_m+P_m P_n+A_n, C_1=Q_m P_n+P_m Q_n, C_2=A_m B_n+B_m A_n with external products and signed two-cell axes. Mature K_mn gives H_1=U_m U_n and H_0=1. In the rational representation ring, substituting P=1+U, A=1+U+V, B=U+W, Q=1+2U+V+W in H_2=C_2-C_1+C_0+H_1-H_0 cancels all except V_m W_n + W_m V_n; finite-group rational semisimplicity upgrades the virtual identity to a module isomorphism. Integer boundary ranks modulo prime 1000003 and independently calculated signed Lefschetz traces pass all S_m and S_n conjugacy-class pairs for nine small parameter choices; the uniform proof is not inferred from them.

originality.rationale: The conclusion is the full independent S_m times S_n rational H_2 decomposition for all m,n>=4, not merely Betti numbers or diagonal S_n restrictions. The 2010 mature-graph theorem supplies the H_1 input without this character, a previous K_{3,n} theorem covers a deliberately excluded boundary, and the 2026 balanced-family result considers diagonal symmetry alone. Other indexed results concerning sink collisions or different complexes do not imply the ordinary configuration-space representation. Bibliographic incompleteness is acknowledged.
residual_risks: Not every article on graph braid group symmetric representations or unpublished thesis was inspected; an equivalent full S_m times S_n formula could exist under alternative notation.

The 2026 balanced-diagonal computation uses related methods; extending its techniques could independently recover the representation, but its stated conclusions and hypotheses do not give this theorem directly.
The sink-configuration indexed result was compared using its detailed scientific abstract rather than full text; its collision condition is materially different.

value.rationale: Determines two explicit multiplicity-one irreducible symmetry channels for the full two-factor group throughout an infinite two-parameter rectangular family. The two summands distinguish left and right symmetric and alternating cycle interactions, cannot be reconstructed from known Betti numbers or diagonal balanced-group characters, and show full-group invariant H_2 vanishes. This is a natural equivariant topology classification, not merely finite computation or a special-case rank increment.
